baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled occurrence of f-d-l at words 2 and 9 is joined to the active transfer verb at word 4 and to an open recipient construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first branch makes favor an excess beyond a due division, the benefaction branch makes that excess a free grant, and the giving branch makes it move from possessor to recipient. The second f-d-l occurrence closes the line by relocating the abundance in the giver rather than in the recipient's merit.

activation_trace.role: Surplus and remainder supply excess beyond need or division, making the favor more than a wage or due share.
Benefaction and free gift turn the surplus into an unowed transfer rather than inert remainder.
Giving and bringing supply the active conveyance by which the surplus reaches a recipient.
Will related to bringing a thing about makes divine selection, not prior recipient entitlement, the initiating condition.

changed_reading.before: A generic divine favor is bestowed on a chosen person.
changed_reading.after: An unowed surplus is actively brought into a recipient's reach; its source, route, and selection remain with God rather than becoming the recipient's earned property.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both instances of f-d-l can name degree as well as benefaction, while the genitive and giving construction assign that degree to God as source and allocator.
baseline_models.mechanism: The degree branch keeps status and excellence live within favor, but the adjacent self-superiority branch exposes its unstable double. Because the verse calls it God's favor and says He gives it, legitimate distinction is conferred; it is not identical with a recipient's performance of superiority over peers.

activation_trace.role: Degree, excellence, and comparative elevation keep a status-bearing sense of favor available.
Claiming superiority supplies the shadow mechanism by which received distinction can be misread as self-owned rank.
The explicit act of giving makes any genuine degree conferred rather than self-generated.

changed_reading.after: Favor can include real distinction or elevation, but the line simultaneously de-owns that rank and warns against converting divine conferral into self-asserted precedence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb yu'tihi at word 4 carries branches of approach, channeling, remote inflow, and yield beside its ordinary giving sense; f-d-l supplies the excess being moved.
baseline_models.mechanism: A material reading coalesces in which excess does not simply change hands. It approaches through a prepared access, is routed like water, can arrive from beyond the recipient's locality, and is known by resulting growth. This remains a model of bestowal, but its unit is a productive flow rather than a detachable object.

activation_trace.role: Excess and remainder provide the surplus that can enter circulation.
Approach through the proper face and readiness supplies an access condition for the inflow.
A watercourse and the clearing of its path supply the routing mechanism.
Floodwater arriving from another land supplies nonlocal arrival into a place that did not generate the resource.
Growth and produce supply yield as the visible consequence of successful bestowal.

changed_reading.before: God hands a bounded benefit to a recipient.
changed_reading.after: God routes a surplus from beyond the recipient through a prepared course, and the gift becomes legible in the yield it releases.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The open man yasha construction is attached to an arrival verb whose inventory includes a stranger entering a people not originally his own.
baseline_models.mechanism: The gift can be read not only as something delivered to an established insider but as an arrival that crosses a boundary of belonging. The unrestricted recipient phrase prevents genealogy or prior membership from being built into the mechanism of selection.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arrival retain the basic movement into a recipient's sphere.
A stranger entering a people supplies the boundary-crossing social image for the arrival.
Free benefaction prevents prior membership from functioning as the price of entry.
Divine willing leaves the recipient class open instead of encoding an inherited boundary.

changed_reading.before: A favor is allocated among an assumed set of eligible insiders.
changed_reading.after: The favor can itself be a boundary-crossing arrival, with divine willing opening reception beyond inherited belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cosmic swimming or running supplies pervasive motion, kingship supplies ownership and disposal, and wise restraint supplies correction of motion. Together they revise the channel baseline: favor circulates through a governed domain rather than leaking automatically or arriving by caprice.

activation_trace.role: The watercourse image supplies a route through which the focus gift can circulate.
Benefaction identifies what the routed motion conveys.
Swimming, running, and free movement give the surrounding creation a field of circulation.
Ownership with power of disposal assigns control of that circulation to the giver.
Restraint and turning back for repair make the circulation regulated and purposive rather than indiscriminate.

structural_cues: 62:1 spans heavens and earth before naming the King, Holy, Mighty, and Wise.
The focus repeats the divine name on both sides of the act of giving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic motion, disposal, and corrective restraint; I supply the arrow that the sovereign giver routes surplus through an ordered domain. A live alternative is that the motion contributes only praise and no distributive mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The channel image could imply an automatic natural overflow or an opaque choice.
changed_reading.after: The favor is a governed circulation within divine ownership: mobile and widely available in scope, yet directed, restrained, and repaired by wisdom.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dispatched messenger stirs a stationary population, transmits in sequence, discloses signs, joins units into a book, and cultivates increase and soundness. The deictic opening can therefore gather the preceding mission into the focus noun: favor is a transformative transmission system, not merely the status of having a messenger.

activation_trace.role: Increase and surplus let the mission's effect count as generated growth.
Benefaction names the whole transformative sequence as an unowed gift.
Stirring what is stationary supplies the initial activation of recipients.
Succession in segments supplies repeated transmission rather than a single deposit.
Growth and increase make recipient transformation the productive effect of the sequence.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the cognitive opening produced by teaching.
Joining one unit to another supplies integration of the transmitted pieces into a durable whole.

structural_cues: 62:2 presents a causal sequence of dispatch, recitation, purification, and teaching before 62:4 opens with a backward-pointing deictic.
The mission is located among its first recipients rather than delivered as a disembodied object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered acts and their branch mechanics; I infer that the deictic bundles this process as a principal referent of favor and that growth is its effect. The live alternative is that favor is broader than this mission even while including it.

changed_reading.before: Favor is the one-time donation of a messenger or text.
changed_reading.after: Favor is an activating curriculum: dispatch initiates motion, repeated transmission discloses and integrates, and purification appears as recipient growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Others are temporally delayed yet remain capable of catching the first group, attaching to it, and appearing as later fruit. This strengthens the focus stranger model by giving the open recipient phrase a social and temporal mechanism: the favor propagates beyond its first cohort without requiring simultaneity or ancestry.

activation_trace.role: The outsider entering a people supplies cross-boundary arrival in the focus.
Later yield gives propagation a productive result rather than mere relocation.
Delay until a later time extends reception beyond the first moment.
A later party catching what is ahead supplies temporal convergence with the first recipients.
Attaching one who belongs to a people supplies social incorporation rather than mere proximity.
Fruit following the first crop supplies organic continuation by a later cohort.

structural_cues: 62:3 names others from the first recipients who have not yet joined them.
62:4 follows this unfinished not-yet relation with an unrestricted whoever construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delayed others, catching, attachment, and later fruit; I infer that divine giving stays open across cohort boundaries. A live alternative is that 62:3 identifies a determinate later group without making every boundary equally permeable.

changed_reading.before: Divine choice distributes favor within the first historical audience.
changed_reading.after: Divine choice keeps the transmission temporally unfinished: later outsiders can be attached, catch up, and become a second fruit of the same favor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The carrying inventory distinguishes an externally lifted load, inward pregnancy or fruit, and accepted responsibility. The following comparison repeats carrying around books that disclose writing. This revises bestowal by separating delivery from realization: a revealed deposit may remain an external burden, while favor becomes productive when it is borne inwardly and answers its trust.

activation_trace.role: Giving supplies the initial transfer whose reception is being tested.
Yield supplies a criterion by which delivery becomes productive reception.
Free benefaction keeps the initial gift unearned even when its later use can fail.
Lifting a visible load supplies the mode of merely external possession.
Inner carrying and fruit supply the contrasting mode of assimilated, generative reception.
Bearing a trust or burden supplies the recipient's answerable relation to what was given.
A book that uncovers writing supplies disclosed content that can still remain only cargo.

structural_cues: 62:5 repeats the same carrying root for being charged, failing to bear, and bearing volumes.
The comparison immediately follows the focus declaration of favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies external load, inner fruit, responsibility, and revealing books; I infer a contrast between transfer and realized reception. The live alternative is that the favor remains fully given even when recipients reduce its content to cargo.

changed_reading.before: To be given revelation is simply to possess its content.
changed_reading.after: The grant remains free, but its living form is inward and fruitful bearing; external custody alone can turn the same disclosed content into weight without transformation.

context_deltas.mechanism: An uncertain claim is attached to nearness, entitlement, and exclusion of other people. This activates the split already latent inside f-d-l between conferred distinction and performed superiority. The focus line therefore blocks a group from turning divine favor into hereditary monopoly without denying every form of genuine distinction.

activation_trace.role: Real degree and excellence preserve the possibility of genuine conferred distinction.
Claiming superiority names the distortion produced when distinction is self-owned and displayed.
Speech without certainty marks the exclusive status assertion as a claim requiring proof.
Nearness without an interval supplies the claimed intimacy with God.
Priority and entitlement expose the juridical form that claimed intimacy takes.
Otherness supplies the exclusionary boundary drawn against the rest of humanity.

structural_cues: 62:6 frames exclusive friendship as a conditional claim and immediately demands a costly truth test.
The focus attributes both instances of favor to God before this claim appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claimed nearness, entitlement, and exclusion; I infer that 62:4 preemptively de-owns exclusive rank. A live alternative is that the challenge rejects this claimant's truthfulness specifically rather than every durable communal distinction.

changed_reading.before: Divinely favored status can be possessed as an exclusive group title.
changed_reading.after: Any real elevation remains a conferral, while exclusive entitlement is exposed as the self-superiority shadow of favor rather than favor itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hand can signify both favor and what hands acquire, while advancing, witnessed disclosure, and intended action trace what recipients send forward. This creates an asymmetrical economy: divine favor is not payment for deeds, but once given it becomes capacity and trust whose use is eventually made present.

activation_trace.role: Free benefaction keeps the source of capacity prior to and larger than recipient performance.
Giving establishes the incoming side of the asymmetrical exchange.
Advancing something forward supplies the outgoing temporal direction of recipient action.
The hand as favor mirrors divine giving inside the recipient's own agency.
What hands acquire supplies the answerable output produced with received capacity.
Knowledge made explicit supplies the disclosure that renders use inspectable.
Intended action supplies the concrete output of the recipient's use of favor.

structural_cues: 62:7 moves from what hands sent ahead to divine knowledge, and 62:8 ends with disclosure of what was done.
The focus's incoming pronoun object is followed later by a return toward the knower of hidden and witnessed reality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies incoming gift, human acquisition, return, and disclosure; I supply the arrow that gift creates entrusted capacity whose use is answerable. The live alternative is that these verses deny false privilege without specifying any merit relation between favor and deeds.

changed_reading.before: Favor is an unconditional privilege detached from what follows reception.
changed_reading.after: Favor is unearned on arrival yet ethically productive: it equips hands, and what those hands advance later discloses whether the grant became action.

context_deltas.mechanism: A public call gathers dispersed people, purposeful movement interrupts exchange, completed prayer releases them to spread through the earth, and seeking explicitly takes God's favor as its object. The focus giving is therefore compatible with disciplined human pursuit: gift moves through a rhythm of gathering, reorientation, dispersal, work, and cultivation without becoming wages.

activation_trace.role: Divine giving remains the source-side action throughout the later human movement.
A day or call that gathers people supplies the centripetal phase of the cycle.
Purposeful movement toward a sought object supplies deliberate reorientation rather than passive waiting.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the centrifugal release into many paths.
Seeking a thing makes recipient pursuit an authorized means within the giving mechanism.
The reappearing benefaction explicitly names divine favor as what dispersed seekers pursue.
The farmer splitting earth supplies cultivation as the material endpoint of disciplined dispersion.
Winning and lasting supply the durable outcome sought through the cycle.

structural_cues: 62:9 orders a call, movement to remembrance, and suspension of sale; 62:10 orders completion, dispersal, seeking, and renewed remembrance.
The same f-d-l noun from the focus becomes the explicit object of seeking in 62:10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the imperative sequence and the repeated favor noun; I infer that human seeking is one routed mode of divine giving rather than its rival or price. A live alternative is that 62:10 narrows this occurrence to provision while 62:4 remains primarily the revelatory mission.

changed_reading.before: Whomever He wills suggests passive allotment independent of recipient movement.
changed_reading.after: Divine giving can arrive through a trained rhythm: gather and reorient, disperse and seek, cultivate and remember, with pursuit nested inside gift rather than earning it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Profit-seeking and diversion seize sight and fracture an assembled body, while nearness with God and apportioned provision establish a different source and measure of value. Since trade was authorized in 62:10, the mechanism is not anti-commerce: great favor orders attention and valuation so that a market can mediate provision without pricing or displacing its source.

activation_trace.role: Surplus supplies value beyond the closed equivalence of a priced exchange.
Free benefaction identifies the source of value that commerce cannot purchase.
Magnitude and force give this source priority over immediately visible profit.
Commerce and sought profit supply the competing valuation system.
Being occupied away from one thing by another supplies the attentional switch that lets price displace presence.
The breaking apart of an assembly supplies the social cost of the attentional switch.
Nearness and presence supply the stable location of the better value.
Apportioned giving supplies provision's source without denying the channels through which it arrives.

structural_cues: 62:11 contrasts what is with God against diversion and trade after people visibly leave the standing messenger.
62:10 had already authorized dispersal to seek favor, preventing a simple sacred-versus-economic split.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies profit, distraction, dispersal, divine presence, and apportioned provision; I infer a hierarchy of attention and value rather than a ban on exchange. The live alternative is a narrower rebuke of one interruption without a general market model.

changed_reading.before: Great favor is one desirable commodity alongside other gains.
changed_reading.after: Great favor is the source and measure that makes gains intelligible: commerce may carry provision, but visible profit becomes loss when it fractures attention to the giver.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it composes distant water, rain, pasture, and yield branches across the window rather than offering a direct lexical gloss. It remains anchored in the focus's excess and arrival inventories, and several context roots independently continue the water-growth circuit. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for the mechanics of favor, not translate yu'tihi as rain or claim an exclusive ecological sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines f-d-l as excess with yu'tihi branches for a cleared watercourse, floodwater arriving from elsewhere, and resulting produce.

activation_trace.role: Surplus supplies the excess resource that can overflow its place of origin.
A watercourse with a cleared path supplies the channel for distribution.
A flood arriving from a rained-on land to a dry one supplies remote transfer without local origination.
Produce and abundant growth supply the downstream sign that the inflow took effect.
Soft fertile earth supplies a receptive substrate for the routed surplus.
Dew and rain continue the image of a call that gathers by moistening rather than coercing.
Generosity in the same root joins rainfall materially to benefaction socially.
Dry pasture revived by rain supplies renewal after dispersal.
Heavy rain supplies intensity to the sought inflow.
Rain descending as provision closes the circuit by identifying water as apportioned sustenance.

changed_reading.before: Favor is an abstract grant transferred directly to an isolated person.
changed_reading.after: Favor can be imagined as a rain-fed surplus routed from elsewhere into receptive ground, gathering life, reviving what is dry, and becoming visible as yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it fuses a social outsider with botanical growth and later fruit. It remains anchored in yu'tihi's stranger and yield branches and is sharpened by the explicit later attachment in 62:3. Downstream prose should call it a graft analogy for non-genealogical inclusion, not claim that the verse names horticulture or erases the historical identities of its cohorts.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus arrival verb can image both a stranger entering another people and the yield that subsequently comes forth, while the recipient remains whoever God wills.

activation_trace.role: The entering stranger supplies the non-genealogical element introduced into an existing body.
Emergent produce supplies fruit as evidence that the introduced element has become generative.
Free benefaction makes incorporation a grant rather than a genealogical entitlement.
Growth and increase supply the living process by which incorporation changes the recipient body.
Attaching someone to a people supplies the graft-like social joining.
Fruit that follows the first crop supplies delayed productivity after attachment.

changed_reading.before: Later outsiders are merely added to an already complete favored group.
changed_reading.after: Favor behaves like a grafted newcomer: attachment changes belonging, and later fruit shows that inclusion has become generative rather than merely numerical.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the bone sense inside azim and composes it with carrying, support, and standing. It remains anchored in the focus adjective and gains a coherent contrast from the externally carried books and the standing figure later in the window. Downstream prose should render it as a bodily-architectural analogy for capacity under weight, not as a lexical replacement of 'great' with 'skeletal.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus adjective at word 10 has a solid-bone branch, allowing the great favor to be tested as inner structure rather than only large quantity or prestige.

activation_trace.role: Solid bone supplies an inner frame capable of bearing force.
A grave descending event supplies the heavy circumstance in which structure is tested.
Benefaction makes the load-bearing capacity itself a gift rather than self-made toughness.
An externally lifted load supplies the failed alternative: weight rests on a bearer without becoming structure.
Inner carrying and fruit supply incorporation of weight into living capacity.
A support that bears and prevents falling supplies the architectural function of the inner frame.
Bodily uprightness supplies the visible result of load-bearing fidelity when others disperse.

changed_reading.before: Great favor means a very large or prestigious benefit.
changed_reading.after: Great favor can be carried as an inner frame: it turns entrusted weight into the capacity to remain upright, unlike information borne only as external cargo.

strongest_changes: The preceding mission turns favor from a donated object into an activating sequence of transmission, integration, purification, and growth.
The delayed others make divine selection temporally open and socially incorporative rather than confined to a first cohort.
The carrying comparison separates external custody from inward, fruitful, answerable reception.
The gathering-dispersal sequence reconciles divine giving with purposeful human seeking without reducing favor to wages.
The final market scene makes favor a source and measure of value that can use commerce while refusing to be priced or displaced by it.
summary.what_was_special: The focus-only inventories already held unusually concrete alternatives: excess, conferred rank, a stranger's arrival, water routing, remote flood, yield, and solid bone. Context did not collapse these into one theme; it activated distinct social, pedagogical, ecological, economic, ethical, and load-bearing mechanisms that can coexist.
remaining_uncertainties: The deictic most naturally gathers the preceding mission, but the focus's formulation can exceed that immediate referent.
The exact relation between divine willing and recipient seeking remains asymmetric but underdetermined: seeking can be a route of gift without explaining selection.
The rain, graft, and skeletal models are coherent material analogies built from packet branches, but they should not be promoted into direct lexical translations.
External possession may represent failed realization of a genuine gift rather than absence of the gift itself.
